profile.headline: Highly Energetic professional with 25+ yrs experience across industries. Currently designing, building and testing test automation platforms for embedded software, databases, APIs, & mobile, and web apps, etc.
profile.summary:
Sr. Software Quality Engineering Manager with 12+ years of IT Experience in B2B and B2C markets. 
I improve product quality by understanding customer needs, clearly defining expectations, investing in personnel, implementing robust controls, fostering collaboration, and always striving to improve.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks for API, and
backend systems.
• Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and test engineers to
define test strategies and ensure comprehensive coverage.
• Investigate and resolve issues in software and automation pipelines, contributing
to continuous improvement.
• Evaluate and integrate new tools and technologies to enhance testing efficiency
and effectiveness.
• Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in test automation and
software quality.
• Participate in code reviews, offering insights on testability and overall quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Software Quality Assurance · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.description: Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks for API, and backend systems. Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and test engineers to define test strategies and ensure comprehensive coverage. Investigate and resolve issues in software and automation pipelines, contributing to continuous improvement. Evaluate and integrate new tools and technologies to enhance testing efficiency and effectiveness. Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in test automation and software quality. positions.description: Skills: Marketing · System Administration · IT Governance

positions.title: System Consultant
positions.description: IT and Business Consultant for small business. Advised members on all aspects of IT Governance, business operations, marketing and other items as needed including creating email marketing campaigns, FB & IG campaigns, etc. Maintained cloud-based systems to ensure optimal performance, security. Performed systems maintenance tasks and coordinated with cloud providers to ensure platform stability. Managed WordPress sites and performed coding tasks in PHP, HTML, etc. as needed. Developed IT governance policies and procedures to ensure compliance with HIPAA and other business requirements.

positions.title: Senior Quality Engineering Manager
positions.description: Skills: Software Testing · Jenkins · Selenium · Product Service · Engineering Process · Client Relations · Quality Assurance · Training · Scaled Agile Framework · Regulatory Standards · Defining Requirements · Scrum · Documentation · Influence At All Levels · Communication · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Java · Knowledge Acquisition · Quality Assurance Professionals · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Training and Development (HR)

positions.title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
positions.description: Managed various local (US) and offshore (International) QA & QE resources in SAFE Agile Methodologies to test SaaS Application on AWS environments in the cloud, mobile devices, and emulation using manual tests and automation using Selenium and Playwright in CI/CD pipelines. Strengthened client relationships and lead initiative resulting in 5-10% app performance improvement through root cause analysis. Identified gaps in test reporting metrics and delivered key process improvements to support decision making. Lead initiatives that resulted in 20% reduction in repository items requiring maintenance. Empowered team to transition automation scripts from Selenium to Playwright to improve performance and stability.

positions.title: IT Quality Assurance Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for development and implementation of IT Quality Assurance strategies
Assessed organizational challenges and orchestrated changes to improve performance
Coordinated with Development and Operations leadership and personnel to optimize business processes
Served as chief architect and administrator for Quality Assurance and Test Automation platform.
Designed, built, and trained team to use Test Automation Platform based on python, Robot Framework, and other combined tools
Supported the testing process by building automated tests as part of the software development lifecycle
Installed and integrated additional tools like Jenkins, Buildbot, RCC and to enhance the testing process
Managed a team of QA testers and automation engineers through the entire performance management lifecycle
Served as liaison to internal stakeholders to coordinated user acceptance testing and production verification activities
Reviewed test artifacts for completeness and readiness for deployment
Collaborated with development professionals on deployment and release processes
Provided documentation and reports to key stakeholders regarding upcoming activities, deliverables, potential roadblocks, etc.

positions.title: Information Technology Quality Assurance Manager
positions.description: Managed all aspects of IT QA Organization including hiring, training, performance and disciplinary actions. Improved operations efficiency by administering JIRA to remove roadblocks and streamline processes. Coordinated test planning, test plan design, repository management and other standard QA practices.

positions.title: Member
positions.description: Served Customers with lots of energy and a smile. Took Customer Orders at the main registers and drive-thru. Ensured orders were accurate, complete and to the customer’s satisfaction. Assisted with cooking, inventory management, cleaning and maintenance. Supported any other areas as needed.

positions.title: Specialist Senior / Senior Consultant / Software Asset Management
positions.description:
● Software Asset Management Consultant specializing in tool operation management and training
● Assess and analyze data pertaining to client environment to optimize the software estate
● Evaluate Software license requirements and contract data against existing software deployments to assess the degree
of compliance
● Develop go-to-market documentation regarding standard approaches for the Software License Management process
● Support procurement, IT Sourcing, End User Software Delivery, Technical Support and other stakeholders in managed
service delivery model to maintain high-quality customer service and improve customer satisfaction
● Perform qualitative and quantitative analyses of data sets to prioritize strategies for delivering high impact results

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description: Managed $100M + portfolios of hardware and software assets for multiple clients. Optimized clients’ software license portfolios to reduce costs and maximize efficiency of product usage by over $1M. Established Software Asset Management strategies, implementation and integration processes and procedures. Developed methodologies and processes to effectively gather, analyze, and consume data from contracts, purchases, deployments, and other sources to determine compliance for vendors including Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe, IBM and others. Set IT Service Management standards and guidelines for servicing client needs based on industry best practices. Used FlexNet Manager and other SAM tools to collect data. Delivered executive-level dashboards to clients to summarize key metrics and results.

positions.title: Application Integration Specialist
positions.description:
Application Integration Specialist (E-Discovery)
•	Spearheaded the Transition of the Development Quality Assurance Team from Quality Center ALM and QTP to Microsoft Test Manager, Team Foundation Server, and Visual Studio
•	Orchestrated updates to ALM Platform, Installed and Configured Hyper-V, System Center 2012 Setup up Automated Deploy/Build Workflow to Lab Center Environments
•	Evaluated and Configured Test Automation Framework Solutions for Integration with ALM
•	Created and Executed Web Performance/Load Tests using Visual Studio
•	Customized TFS Process Templates and Workflow for SDLC management
•	Collaborated with QA Analysts to plan, develop and maintain regression tests
•	Created SQL Queries for data-mining and integrated data generation and developed custom SSRS Reports from TFS
•	Developed and executed automated, functional and manual regression tests using Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, and modified methodologies

positions.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
positions.description: Lead automation efforts to build Software Testing platform. Automation Engineer for .NET Applications, Desktop and Web Applications. Design, create and edit automated tests. Create SQL queries for data-mining and integrated data generation. Configure Team Foundation Server for manual and automated testing. Established organizational IT quality assurance standards. Developed Reporting procedures for tracking issues, bugs/defects, tasks, and other items. Organized IT configuration management process. Coordinated releases with developers, analysts, and other stakeholders. Collaborate with Quality Analysts to plan, develop, and maintain regression tests. Design and Implement Frameworks for unified testing. Setup and upgrade testing tools based on company requirements.
